# stalwart_spam_dnsbl_server_url (Resource)

Defines a DNSBL server used for spam filtering lookups. Manages the URL variant.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A unique name for this DNSBL server configuration
- `zone` (Attributes) Expression that returns the DNS zone to query. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zone))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for the DNSBL server
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether to enable this DNSBL server
- `tag` (Attributes) Expression that returns the tag to assign to the message. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tag))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
